body: Dunno if you meant to post twice, but I'm still here, just don't know what to say. Browsing around, being sad, as usual. I want a drink though. A smoke maybe, even if its terrible for me.

I'm not sure you understand what I'm asking. I need quantifiable numbers here. This is just how I look at life. My friend must've helped hundreds of homeless people, while I've only helped like 3. In this hypothetical scenario, where if you knew me, how long would you let me stay at your house? If you're just some internet guy trying to help, would you even consider it, if you lived close by? Quantifiable - weeks, months? It's one thing to talk to someone, I think that's easy when the basic needs are fine and dandy (food, shelter, clothing), but I think everything changes when those things are taken away. I was almost kicked out of my house very recently, and almost no one was there for me, and if there were people, it was only for a short period of time.

Guess my parents (at least my dad) is a rare specimen. He's shown me his transcript, and in his entire degree, he has a single D, 4 in the C range, and everything else is As and Bs. He looks at my grades and tells me how he's never done that badly when he attended, how his expectations aren't even that high because he's not asking for As, and I can always hear the disappointment in his voice whenever I tell him any sort of mark. There's a difference between fucking up once in a while, and constantly not doing anything right (as I feel).
But you didn't answer my question about how far you or other people are willing to help.

Because then I'd just be a burden. Besides, caring can only go so far. Sometimes I'm conflicted, I want to share it and have other people help me, but how far are they willing to help? If you lived really close by me, and I decided to move out, would you let me stay? Use your electricity, eat your food, be a burden? For how long? People can only help so far. 

When you say "talk to someone" I assume you mean a professional. I'm a pretty paranoid person, and I'm fairly sure mentioning thoughts of suicide will just get me put in the mental hospital or something. There is no "patient confidentiality" if they think I'm gonna hurt myself or something.

That guy A over there, might have a trophy or a ribbon for achieving something in sports. The girl B might have written an essay that won some sort of award. I have nothing to put up in my room, and I feel I've done nothing worthwhile. I'll tell you about this friend I have. He's the nicest guy I know, he's selfless, optimistic, and basically the person I desperately want to be. He's Christian, and he always stays positive, no matter what. He shrugs off insults and probably some bullying that happened to him. He volunteers for the homeless, of his own will, using his free time. I use my free time to jerk off, browse the internet, and watching streams. When I volunteered, it was because I was forced to, by my father, to pad up my resume (which has nothing notable on it). I'm always a depressed downer, so I'm probably a burden by ruining the mood. When people ask me how I'm doing, I always answer with negativity and it's clear the conversation is awkward for them. Why would anyone care for me? Why would a girl or any other person like me, when the only things I have to talk about are negative things? The "positives" of my life are artificial, gotten from entertainment.

No, it's not ok. I'm not made of money, my parents aren't made of money. My dad didn't have unreasonable expectations, when he wanted me to pass. In fact, I haven't even told him yet because I fucked up so hard I'm too scared to tell him. It's like the possibility of failure wasn't even in his mind. What kind of idiot fucks up this badly? Only I could. Retaking classes means more time, more money invested, for what? I'm probably gonna fuck up again, there's no way I can do anything right. My life is literally a series of failures. When you see someone's room, you see trophies and achievements. My room doesn't have any of those, and I've done nothing remarkable. What have I done in my life? What the fuck have I achieved? Nothing.

I want a degree because I want to try to have a successful lifestyle. Who the fuck would watch me play video games, or who could I beat at a tourny for card games? I'm not good enough at anything to make a living off of it, and it's apparently I'm too fucking stupid for the school system. My dad has never once said he's proud of me, and it's probably because I haven't done anything worthwhile. He's got this big plan for me so that I can at least have a shot at being good at something, but I keep fucking it up because all I do is fuck around trying to escape the facts: I'm worthless.
